approvals.title: Idhini
approvals.none: Hakuna bechi zinazolingana na vichujio hivi.
approvals.footnote: Bechi zenye tofauti za lita zimeangaziwa. Tumia kichujio cha hali kuona bechi Zilizorekodiwa, Zilizokataliwa na Zilizolipwa.

approvals.emailFailed: Barua pepe haikutumwa; tafadhali mjulishe mkulima.

reports.title: Ripoti
reports.previewHint: Chagua ripoti na tarehe, kisha bofya Tengeneza ripoti ili uone muhtasari.
reports.noteMismatch: Bechi ambazo lita zilizopimwa na mkaguzi ni tofauti na zile alizotaja mkulima. Tofauti = zilizopimwa toa zilizotajwa.
reports.noteLitres: Lita ni zile zilizopimwa kama bechi imekaguliwa, la sivyo ni zile zilizotajwa.
reports.errDates: Tarehe ya "Kuanzia" lazima iwe kabla ya tarehe ya "Hadi".
reports.errFarmer: Weka jina la mkulima kwa taarifa ya mkulima.
